prompt: What was the name of the work written by Louis Pierre Vieillot published two years after he described the great blue turao as Musophaga cristata?
answer: The work was **_Nouveau dictionnaire d’histoire naturelle_** (“New Dictionary of Natural History”), to which Vieillot contributed ornithological material. It was published in installments during **1816–1819**, including **1818**, two years after his description of the great blue turaco as *Musophaga cristata*.
